note: State park on Lake Andrew near New London. Lakeview Campground sits on the wooded slope above the swimming beach and boat launch; Oak Ridge Campground is in the woods to the north-east. Mt. Tom Trail climbs to a lookout tower, and there are horse trails, an interpretive center and kayak and canoe rental at the beach store in summer. --Claude

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. ReserveMN gives '.1 mile' (sites 30-41) or '.2 mile' to the water for every Lakeview site. Imagery: the south row of the Lakeview loops (an RV pad at ~45.31390,-95.03810) is 40-45 m above Lake Andrew behind a continuous wooded slope 25-35 m deep; the open shore by the boat launch and beach (~45.3147,-95.0405) is a day-use parking area, not campsites. Oak Ridge is ~800 m inland.

Pin 45.31460,-95.03720 is on the Lakeview loops, ~190 m from ReserveMN's Lakeview facility point (45.31508,-95.03949, which sits by the beach parking): OK. Oak Ridge (ReserveMN 45.31879,-95.02854) is ~820 m away and shares this entry.
